[[Kaira]] is a [[Shining Blade]] member who sorely misses [[Saidra]], and had the task of finding her a final resting place.

==Locations==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
**{{NPC location|Gadd's Encampment}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Saidra was a heroic member of the Shining Blade who sacrificed all to help her friends and our cause. She embodied everything our organization believes in. Ever since the Dwarves of [[Deldrimor]] delivered her ashes to us, I have searched for a fitting place to leave [[Saidra's Ashes|Saidra's remains]]. That place is here in [[Sparkfly Swamp]]."''
